children: IndiQube Spaces Limited, an integrated managed workspace provider, expanded its operational portfolio in the first half of FY27, with its area under management (AUM) rising to 10.86 million sq. ft.
The company added 1.72 million sq. ft. to its managed workspace portfolio year-on-year. Its total seat capacity also increased by 38,000 seats to 2.41 lakh seats during the period.
IndiQube added 13 new centres year-on-year, taking its portfolio to 138 properties across 17 cities in India. The company reported a 91 per cent occupancy rate across its steady-state centres.
The company also received an A+ (Stable) credit rating from CRISIL, reaffirming its financial position.

The operational expansion comes as demand for flexible and managed office spaces continues to develop in India's commercial real estate market. IndiQube provides managed workspace solutions to businesses across multiple sectors.
The company announced its financial and operational performance for the first half and second quarter of FY27.
